title: 8-Week Triathlon Build
summary: Strong run + swim base; the bike is the critical gap. An 8-week build toward triathlon readiness.

disciplines.label: Run
disciplines.goal: long run up to 13 km + quality at goal pace

bike: easy spin 30 min, cadence 85–95 — just get comfortable

run: QUALITY · WU 15 min · 3×6 min @ 5:15/km (2 min jog) · CD 10 min
QUALITY · WU 15 min · 4×6 min @ 5:10/km (90s jog) · CD 10 min
QUALITY · WU 15 min · 2×10 min @ 5:10/km (3 min jog) · CD 10 min
QUALITY · WU 15 min · 5×800 m @ 4:55/km (90s jog) · CD 10 min
EASY · WU 15 min · 5 km time trial (or 25 min easy) · CD 10 min
weeksPlan.note: Checkpoint — test, then set the next block.

prescription.text: Get on the bike — 3 rides/week. Two structured indoor sessions (one endurance 60–75 min, one with 3–4×8 min at threshold) plus one longer weekend ride building ~10%/wk toward 2–3× race distance. This single change moves the needle most.
Add weekly brick workouts — run 10–20 min right off the bike. Triathlon running happens on tired legs; train that feeling.
Make one swim longer & open-water specific — a continuous race-distance effort; practice sighting toward race day.
Lift run cadence from ~154 toward ~170 spm to reduce impact and hold form off the bike. Use short strides 1–2×/week.
Keep strength but periodize it — trim to 2×/week as the race nears and shift freed time to the bike.
Mind the load ramp — last 4 weeks averaged 207 load/week (+128%). Keep weekly jumps under ~10% and take a lighter week every 4th.
